name: Frame Windows
description: Live 60fps frame-perfect candidates + NaNDL-style 240Hz frame windows, in-game precision (sigma/s), and one-click export to nandl.pages.dev calculator JSON.

overlay-enabled.name: Show overlay
overlay-enabled.description: Show the NaN-style bucket counter list while playing.

nan-popups.name: Ring popups
nan-popups.description: Spawn a bucket-colored ring + window number at the player when a tight timing is detected (like NaN's videos).

popup-time.name: Popup lifetime (s)
popup-time.description: How long each ring popup stays on screen.

count-releases.name: Count releases
count-releases.description: Count releases as inputs too (NaN GD timings include releases).

clear-on-reset.name: Clear on retry
clear-on-reset.description: Restart the recording each attempt (recommended). Disable to accumulate across attempts.

auto-export.name: Auto-export on quit
auto-export.description: Write the NaNDL JSON files automatically when leaving a level.

game-fps.name: Game FPS
game-fps.description: Tick rate the run is recorded at. Matches the calculator's Game FPS.

window-fps.name: Window FPS
window-fps.description: Timing-window rate for frame windows and precision. NaNDL uses 240.

respawn-time.name: Respawn time (s)
respawn-time.description: Added to every attempt time, same as the calculator field.

fp60-ticks.name: 60FP ticks
fp60-ticks.description: Neighbour distance (240Hz ticks) at/below which an input is a classic 60fps frame-perfect candidate. 4 ticks = one 60Hz frame.

tight-cutoff.name: Tight cutoff
tight-cutoff.description: Neighbour distance (240Hz ticks) at/below which an input gets a numeric 0-10 window guess. Wider spacings export as '-' (ignored).
